source: Census Household Trends and Outlook Pulse Survey corrected March 2026 PUF
weight: PWEIGHT with PWEIGHT1-PWEIGHT80 successive-difference replicate weights
group_definition: EXPENSE_DIFFICULT: 1 not at all, 2 a little, 3 somewhat, 4 very difficult

outcome_definitions.art_exhibit: ARTEXHIBIT=1 yes in prior four weeks
outcome_definitions.create_art: CREATEART=1 yes in prior four weeks
outcome_definitions.club_meeting: SOC_CLUBS=2, 3, or 4 at least one meeting in prior year
outcome_definitions.public_meeting: ATTENDMEETING=1 yes public meeting for local issue in prior year

boundary: Same-round descriptive respondent-weighted conditional shares; expense difficulty is household-reported, cultural and civic outcomes are respondent-reported, and March 2026 is cross-sectional. No causal, longitudinal, household-level, or practical-exit estimate is implied.
